title: Toyota Tundra Engines by Year (2000–2026)
description: Every factory engine in the Toyota Tundra by year, 2000–2026: the 3.4 and 4.0 V6s, the 4.7, 4.6 and 5.7 V8s, and the twin-turbo i-FORCE and hybrid V6.
intro: Toyota's full-size Tundra pickup arrived for 2000, built in Indiana and later in Texas. Hybrid ratings are for engine and motor combined; dealer-installed TRD superchargers are not listed.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: First generation
intro: The 3.4 5VZ-FE V6 and the 4.7 2UZ-FE V8, then the 4.0 1GR-FE V6 from 2005; ratings from 2006 reflect a change in the SAE test.

generations.name: Second generation
intro: The 4.0 V6, the 4.7 and then 4.6 V8, and the 5.7 3UR-FE V8, the only engine from 2020.

generations.name: Third generation
intro: The 3.4 V35A-FTS twin-turbo V6 in three outputs, including the i-FORCE MAX hybrid.

method: Every engine and year listed here was confirmed by at least three independent sources: the NHRA Stock Car Classification Guides, factory material such as GM Heritage Center information kits and sales brochures, EPA records and established references. Several Wikipedia articles count as one source. Where sources give different ratings, the factory figure is shown and the difference is noted. Factory race-only packages need two sources.
